hub.title: Connection to the service
hub.subscriptionHint: The portal needs an active subscription. Check your account at
hub.keyHint: Check the API key in the server configuration and restart the service.

overview.unavailable: The service did not return these figures just now.

customers.title: Customers
customers.hint: Accounts with the service and the portal logins that belong to them.
customers.noLoginHint: This customer cannot sign in to this portal yet.
customers.empty: No customers yet. Add the first one.
customers.suspendMessage: Suspend {{email}}? The portal and the service are blocked right away.
customers.deleteMessage: Delete the customer {{email}} for good? The account and the portal login go together.

dialog.createIntro: The account with the service and the portal login are created together.
dialog.sendInvite: Send the invitation by e-mail right away

balance.title: Balance
balance.hint: The prepaid wallet of the customer, in euros.
balance.insufficient: The wallet does not hold that much. Available: {{balance}}.

usage.title: Usage
usage.empty: Nothing was used in this period.

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: Plans are what your customers subscribe to. Type, billing cycle and allowances are fixed once a plan exists.
plans.empty: No plan has been created yet.
plans.deleteMessage: The plan "{{name}}" will be deleted. Existing subscriptions prevent that.

dialog.editIntro: Type, billing cycle and allowances of an existing plan can no longer be changed.
dialog.addonHint: On an add-on package the allowance is also the size of the package.

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.intro: These two prices apply to what your customers use. Your margin is the difference.
pricing.suggestionsIntro: A suggestion only fills the fields. Nothing is stored until you save.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.intro: Every subscription ties one customer to one plan and a term.
subscriptions.cancelMessage: The subscription of {{customer}} runs for another 30 days and ends then.
subscriptions.cancelImmediateMessage: The subscription of {{customer}} ends at once. Nothing is refunded and there is no way back.

dialog.title: New subscription
dialog.intro: The subscription starts at once and ends after the chosen term.
dialog.customerHint: Only customers that already exist can hold a subscription.

users.title: Users
users.empty: No users yet. Invite the first person.
users.linkMessage: No mail server is configured. Pass this link on in person. It is valid for a limited time only.

dialog.inviteIntro: The person receives a link to choose their password.
dialog.customerHint: Customer number from your partner account with the service. Without it the person sees no usage data.

branding.intro: Name, logo and colour appear throughout the portal and in the e-mails.
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, at most 140 KB.
branding.logoType: Please choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image.
branding.logoTooLarge: The logo must be 140 KB or smaller.

mail.intro: The portal sends invitations and password reset links through this server.
mail.envSource: Configured through the server environment. Settings on this page take precedence.
mail.notConfigured: No mail server configured yet. Invitation links then have to be passed on by hand.
mail.passKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password.
mail.removeMessage: The stored SMTP credentials will be deleted. The server environment applies again afterwards, if anything is configured there.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: All changes made by administrators and security-relevant events.
